gui.faautoroute.title: AutoRoute Planner
gui.faautoroute.ready: Set a destination, then Preview or Plan & Load.
gui.faautoroute.look_set: Destination set to the block you are looking at.
gui.faautoroute.look_miss: No block in view; using your view direction.
command.faautoroute.loaded: AutoRoute: loaded %s waypoints, cruise Y=%s, %s blocks.
warning.faautoroute.unloaded_samples: %s terrain samples were in unloaded chunks; cruise altitude was set conservatively.
warning.faautoroute.nether_ceiling: Nether ceiling detected; cruise altitude is limited.
warning.faautoroute.cruise_raised: Requested cruise Y=%s was below terrain clearance; raised to Y=%s.
warning.faautoroute.cruise_lowered: Requested cruise Y=%s is above the dimension ceiling; lowered to Y=%s.
error.faautoroute.terrain_too_high: Terrain along the route reaches Y=%s, above the safe ceiling Y=%s.
error.faautoroute.unloaded_destination: The destination chunk is not loaded, so a landing cannot be planned.
error.faautoroute.unsafe_landing_void: The destination is too close to the void.
error.faautoroute.unsafe_landing_fluid: The destination is water or lava. Choose a solid landing spot.
error.faautoroute.unsafe_landing_air: There is no solid ground at the destination.
error.faautoroute.unsafe_landing_leaves: The destination is covered by leaves. Choose a clear landing spot.
error.faautoroute.unsafe_landing_slope: The destination is too uneven for auto-landing (height difference %s).
error.faautoroute.no_waypoints: Could not build a route for these coordinates.
error.faautoroute.auto_land_nether: Auto-land is not available in the Nether: the heightmap sees the bedrock roof, not the ground. Plan an overflight or land manually.
error.faautoroute.unsafe_landing_obstruc: The destination is obstructed within 4 blocks above the ground. Choose an open landing spot.
error.faautoroute.auto_land_too_close: Auto-land needs a route of at least 96 blocks. Disable auto-land or choose a farther destination.
gui.faautoroute.xaero.tooltip: Choose a waypoint from Xaero's map
gui.faautoroute.xaero.title: Xaero Waypoints
gui.faautoroute.xaero.empty: No Xaero waypoints in this world.
gui.faautoroute.waypoints.title: Route Waypoints
gui.faautoroute.waypoints.empty: No via points yet. Add your current position or a Xaero waypoint.
gui.faautoroute.waypoints.more: +%s more (remove one to see the rest)
error.faautoroute.auto_land_short_final: The final leg is too short for auto-landing. Choose a destination farther from the last via point.
gui.faautoroute.auto_land.tooltip: Generate a full approach and landing plan
gui.faautoroute.arm_ap.tooltip: Engage FlightAssistant autopilot and auto-thrust after loading
warning.faautoroute.landing_deferred: Destination chunk is not loaded. An overflight plan was loaded; auto-land will be finalized automatically when the destination chunk loads.
warning.faautoroute.cruise_limited_for_l: Cruise Y=%s was reduced to Y=%s for a flyable descent.
warning.faautoroute.descent_steep: Not enough distance to descend to the destination; expect a steep final approach.
command.faautoroute.ap_on: AutoRoute: autopilot + auto-thrust engaged on the loaded plan.
command.faautoroute.no_plan: AutoRoute: load a flight plan first.
command.faautoroute.landing_finalized: AutoRoute: destination chunk loaded; auto-land plan finalized.
command.faautoroute.landing_too_close: AutoRoute: too close to finalize auto-land; land manually.
error.faautoroute.descent_too_steep: Not enough distance to descend to the destination. The approach would need cruise Y=%s, but terrain clearance needs Y=%s. Choose a farther destination or a lower landing site.
warning.faautoroute.holding_descent: Not enough straight-line distance to descend; inserted a holding pattern to lose altitude before final approach.
warning.faautoroute.approach_terrain: The final approach crosses ground %s blocks above the aim point; the aircraft may touch down before the target. Pick a clearer approach.
command.faautoroute.go_around: Go around %s/%s: approach unrecoverable, climbing away and re-planning
